models.name: basic food-system score
models.section: 3.1 Establishment of the Basic Food System Model
models.summary: Five superior indicators form a set. The score is a sum of five weights times that set, and the set is not indexed. Food's coefficient is one minus the cube root of three percentage changes. Efficiency's coefficient multiplies an economic coefficient by P and by D raised to four property terms.

assumptions: food changes with each climate factor
the efficiency coefficient absorbs market information
